title: Chasing a Dream
content:
Siddu smiled faintly before continuing.

"After that day... something inside me changed."

"I stopped thinking about everything that distracted me."

"I stopped asking myself why life had treated me so unfairly."

"I made only one promise to myself."

"If I truly loved Shreya... then the only way to earn that love was to build a future worthy of it."

"So, I buried every emotion deep inside my heart."

"I stopped looking for her."

"I stopped waiting for her messages."

"I stopped letting memories control me."

"My entire world became one thing..."

"JEE."

Sneha listened quietly.

"From morning until midnight, I studied."

"Whenever I felt tired..."

"I remembered my father's words."

"First build your life."

"They became my motivation."

"I wasn't studying just to clear an examination."

"I was studying for my dream..."

"...and for the future I wanted with Shreya."

Months passed.

The first JEE Main results were announced.

"I had worked harder than ever before, but my score wasn't what I had hoped for."

"I secured a good percentile..."

"...but it wasn't enough to satisfy me."

"I felt disappointed."

"I thought I had failed myself."

Siddu smiled.

"But my father didn't let me think that way."

He placed his hand on my shoulder and said,

"Well done, my boy."

"You're much closer to your dream than you think."

"Those words gave me the confidence to keep going."

Soon...

The Intermediate Public Examinations began.

"Although Shreya and I were in the same college again..."

"I kept my promise."

"I didn't try to speak to her."

"I didn't even look for her."

"It wasn't because I had stopped loving her."

"It was because I had promised myself that I would meet her again only after achieving my goal."

Sneha smiled softly.

"And then..."

"The second JEE Main came."

"This time..."

"I gave everything I had."

"Every sleepless night..."

"Every sacrifice..."

"Every tear..."

"Every moment of pain..."

"It all became my strength."

A proud smile appeared on Siddu's face.

"When the results were announced..."

"I had secured 99.8 percentile in JEE Main."

Sneha's eyes lit up.

"That's incredible!"

Siddu laughed softly.

"I wasn't done yet."

"My biggest battle was still waiting."

"JEE Advanced."

"I walked into that examination hall with only one thought in my mind..."

"This is the final step."

"I wrote the exam with complete focus."

Weeks later...

The results were announced.

"I had made it."

"I had earned my seat in one of the country's finest engineering colleges."

For a brief moment...

Siddu simply smiled.

"That day..."

"...one of my biggest dreams came true."

"I immediately ran to my father."

"The moment I told him..."

"His face lit up with pride."

"He hugged me tightly."

"I could feel something warm on my shoulder."

"When I looked at him..."

"I realized he was crying."

"They weren't tears of sadness."

"They were tears of pride."

"He smiled and said,"

"Congratulations, my son."

"You did it."

Siddu's own eyes softened.

"That was the happiest moment of my life. Every sleepless night, every sacrifice, and every tear suddenly felt worthwhile."

"For the first time..."

"I felt that all my sacrifices had been worth it."

After a brief pause, he continued.

"Then I remembered the promise."

"I looked at my father and asked..."

"Dad..."

"Can I call Shreya now?"

A warm smile appeared on his father's face.

"Of course."

"My heart started racing."

"It had been seven long months."

"Seven months since I had last spoken to her."

"I immediately picked up my phone."

"My hands were trembling as I dialled her number."

The phone rang.

Once...

Twice...

Three times...

"No answer."

"I smiled to myself."

"Maybe she was busy."

"So, I called again."

Still...

"No answer."

"I tried once more."

"And again."

"And again."

"But every call went unanswered."

Siddu's smile slowly disappeared.

"With every unanswered call, my confidence slowly began to fade."

"I refused to give up."

"I dialled her number one last time."

The phone rang briefly.

Then...

The line suddenly became busy.

He lowered his eyes.

"She had rejected my call."

For a few moments...

"I couldn't understand what had happened."

"The dream I had spent seven months chasing had finally come true..."

"Yet the one person I wanted to share it with..."

"Wouldn't even answer my call."

Silence filled the room.

Sneha quietly looked at Siddu.

She could already see that...

"The happiness of achieving his dream..."

"Had lasted only a few minutes."
